test_vectors.coverage: Empty root object; schema metadata and reject_unknown preservation; all five ScalarKind tags and unconstrained Any; lower-only and upper-only integer bounds; separate child nodes; declaration-order slots and required fields; preserved string constraints.
Requiredness/count mismatches in both directions; no input repair; 65536 required fields produce BudgetExhausted because the ABI count is u16.

Each ABI scalar constraint independently rejected on Any; incompatible normalized scalar constraints; all six graph scalar kinds crossed with integer, length, pattern, and format constraints; Decimal constraints required exactly for Decimal.

Duplicate normalized property names and FieldIds; valid empty names; case sensitivity; composed and decomposed Unicode; embedded NUL; non-ASCII keys; duplicate and empty definition names; exact local names including URL-shaped strings.

Empty graph; root, property, array, and definition IDs at the first invalid index and u32::MAX; unreachable invalid nodes; empty references; unknown references and alias-only cycles deferred to the resolver.

Cross-object duplicate FieldIds and slots; equal names in different objects; multiple absent slots; sparse slots including u32::MAX; shared targets; self-referential objects and arrays; legal structural cycles.
Inclusive equal endpoints, absent endpoints, reversed endpoints, i64::MIN/i64::MAX, zero, and u32::MAX; contextual diagnostics for scalar, array, object, and reference failures.

Precision 1 and 38 accepted; 0, 39, and 255 rejected. Target scales 0 and 38 accepted; 39 and 255 rejected. Tick steps 0, 1, and i128::MAX accepted; -1 and i128::MIN rejected. One-sided invalid bound scales rejected even for zero coefficients.

Nineteen fixed vectors and reversed comparisons covering equivalent representations, signs, signed remainders, zero, scale 38, and i128 extremes. A separate safe cross-multiplication oracle covers 784 deterministic small-value comparisons. One-sided and equal extreme bounds are also exercised.

Multi-hop object aliases; scalar aliases return the same borrowed constraint reference; missing and empty property names; stored required-field order; non-scalars return None; wrong kinds return TypeMismatch; invalid IDs return ConstraintViolation; inputs remain unchanged.
